WHO WE ARE & OUR PURPOSE

Creating & Maintaining Water Environments Capable of Safely Sustaining Life.

Deep Blue Aquatic Systems was established to help address the need for specialist aquaculture technology and expertise in Southern Africa. Since then, our capabilities have expanded across a broad range of water-related industries.

At the centre of everything we do is one common objective: creating and maintaining water environments capable of safely sustaining life. That may mean providing the filtration and oxygenation needed for an aquaculture facility, maintaining water quality in a live lobster holding system, protecting trout eggs in a hatchery, supporting marine life in an aquarium or delivering dependable filtration for a high-use swimming pool.

Every project brings different challenges. That is why we focus on understanding the application before developing the solution. Our team brings together experience in aquaculture operations, system design, project management, fabrication, electrical control, monitoring, commissioning and technical consulting. Operating from Strand in the Western Cape, we undertake both South African and international work.

OUR MISSION & VISION

Practical Solutions for Better Water Management

Our objective is to design and deliver reliable aquatic systems that protect water quality, support aquatic life, and advance African aquaculture.

Our Mission

To design and deliver reliable, efficient and sustainable aquatic systems that protect water quality, support aquatic life and help our clients operate with greater control and confidence throughout the operational life of their system.

Dependable Performance

Our Vision

To contribute to the sustainable growth of aquaculture in Africa and help establish the continent as an increasingly important participant in the global aquaculture industry, putting Africa on the world aquaculture map.

African Aquaculture Growth

Custom-Designed Systems

We don’t believe every project needs the same solution. Systems are engineered specifically around species biology, water chemistry, environmental conditions, production targets and operational requirements.

Tailored Solutions

Complete Project Capability

From initial concept, AutoCAD modelling and equipment selection through manufacturing, piping, electrical control, on-site commissioning and ongoing technical support — clients work with one specialist partner.

MEET THE TEAM

Specialist Leadership Behind Every System

Combining practical aquaculture experience with engineering, filtration, electrical switchgear and water-quality monitoring to deliver dependable solutions.

Operations
Operational Director

Grant Brooker

Grant has been involved in aquaculture technology for 13 years, carrying out work on aquaculture and live-holding facilities around the world. Prior to that, Brooker spent a number of years running his own metal work business, followed by 9 years at one of South Africa's larger abalone aquaculture technology suppliers, ending as technology general manager, before starting Deep Blue Aquatic Systems.

Grant is responsible for system design, project management, manufacturing and installation of projects at Deep Blue Aqua. Brooker holds a Diploma in Aquaculture.

System Design & CAD Manufacturing & Installation Diploma in Aquaculture
Technical
Technical Director

Ruben van der Merwe

Ruben has been involved in the aquaculture technology industry for 10 years, carrying out work on aquaculture and live-holding facilities throughout Southern Africa. Ruben's area of specialisation lies on the electrical side of the business.

Ruben is responsible for the design of all motor control systems (switch gear) as well as the monitoring and control division. Ruben holds a Diploma in Aquaculture from the University of Stellenbosch.

Switchgear & Motor Control Monitoring & Automation Stellenbosch Diploma
